flags.text: "Add inline citation badges where citation titles appear in assistant answers, with hover and focus previews and a numbered sources fallback. ([#233](https://github.com/goldbarth/ServiceDeskLite/pull/233))" - Although #233 initially built these badges, #244 removed that implementation during integration and deferred inline badges. #245 later reintroduced them over sanitized Markdown. Presenting #233 as a separate addition in this release misstates what shipped.

"Category and Due appear as separate uppercase headers" - The facts say Category was changed to uppercase, but do not say Due was changed; the verification shows Due was already uppercase. The fix separated the headers and uppercased Category.

"It reports the change as complete only after a tool call succeeds, so you can rely on its account of the result." - The PR added a system-prompt policy requiring a successful tool result before claiming a change was made. The facts do not establish that the assistant always follows that policy, so the guarantee that users can rely on its account is overstated.
